description:
In-process integration: one Beadwork ticket from `/bw run` through implementation child settle without tmux, without closing the ticket automatically.

## Background

First vertical slice that proves the two packages together. Full review loop is the epic e2e. Do not publish on this slice alone.

## Approach

Temporary git+bw fixture. Scripted/stub parent turns. Real orchestrate + session factory. PATH without tmux.

Assert:

- no tmux process/session
- `/bw run` inject happened (captured sendMessage/sendUserMessage)
- orchestrate handle returns before completion
- parent not blocked while child runs
- domain metadata on the child
- settlement does not close the issue
- child active tools include `beadwork_show` and exclude `beadwork_close_issue`
- list_minions shows the orchestrated child with description/taskType

## Success criteria

- Deterministic CI test, no paid LLM.
- Fails loudly with logs if any assert fails.

## Test plan / logging

Every step logs: timestamp, step name, epic id, ticket id, child id, group id, issue status, packet count.

On failure dump: last inject payload, last packet, `bw show` ticket, minion list.

Replace e2e-current-branch-delegate as the canonical path; do not leave tmux e2e as the only documented recipe.

## Considerations

Needs packets, spawn-compat allowlist, /bw run, worker tools gone, inspection tools.
title: Prove one in-process ticket from /bw run through child settlement
